McpWebSearchService_1_0_0_Info.annotation: .NET 10 C# MCP-server proxying web-search requests to a SearXNG instance. Topology: LLM Agent <-> (MCP over stdio) <-> MCP Web Search Service <-> (HTTP) <-> SearXNG. Native AOT publication (linux-x64 for Docker runtime, win-x64 for local AOT-verification). M1 scope: scaffolding from template (complete). M2 scope: configuration layer (complete). M3 scope: DTOs + JsonSerializerContext (complete). M4 scope: HTTP client (complete). M5 scope: Post-processing Pipeline — SearchResultProcessor (complete). M6 scope: Entrypoint wiring + MCP Tools (complete). M7 scope: Dockerization + AOT publish — Dockerfile + .dockerignore (complete). Active ADRs: ADR-001..ADR-025 (see AGENTS.md ADR-001..ADR-016 + DevelopmentPlan.md M7 ADR-017..ADR-025).

BusinessScenarios.Scenario: dotnet new mcpserver --aot -> build -> AOT-publish (win-x64) -> run (stdio host alive)
appsettings.json -> ConfigurationBinder (source-generated) -> IOptions<SearXNGSettings> -> ValidateOnStart -> host starts OR fails with OptionsValidationException
SearXNG JSON (snake_case) -> McpJsonContext.Default.SearXNGResponse -> SearXNGResult[] -> [M5 pipeline] -> SearchResultDto[] -> McpJsonContext.Default.SearchResultDtoArray -> PascalCase JSON to LLM

SearchRequest -> SearXNGClient.SearchAsync -> Circuit Breaker gate -> HTTP GET to SearXNG (15s timeout) -> McpJsonContext.Default.SearXNGResponse deserialize -> IReadOnlyList<SearXNGResult> -> on failure throw SearXNGUnavailableException

IReadOnlyList<SearXNGResult> -> SearchResultProcessor.Process -> NormalizeUrl -> Deduplicate (exact by normalized URL + engine priority, fuzzy by TitleSimilarity ≥0.90 across domains) -> MapToDto -> StripHtml ([GeneratedRegex] + HtmlDecode) -> Truncate (300 chars) -> Filter (blocklist + snippet<20 + Take(MaxResults)) -> SearchResultDto[]

(M6) LLM calls web_search tool -> WebSearchTools.WebSearch -> ISearXNGClient.SearchAsync -> ISearchResultProcessor.Process -> SearchResultDto[] -> JsonSerializer.Serialize(McpJsonContext.Default.SearchResultDtoArray) -> JSON string to LLM (ADR-018). SearXNGUnavailableException -> "Search service temporarily unavailable" string.

(M6) LLM calls fetch_and_extract tool -> WebSearchTools.FetchAndExtract -> IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient("FetchExtract") -> HTTP GET -> HtmlTextExtractor.ExtractPlainText -> plain text ≤5000 chars to LLM (ADR-022).

Constraints.Constraint: No Newtonsoft.Json, no reflection-based serialization, no dynamic codegen. All DTOs via JsonSerializerContext (SPEC §4.1). M3 registers McpJsonContext with [JsonSerializable] for every DTO crossing the JSON boundary.

Configuration binding MUST use EnableConfigurationBindingGenerator=true AND Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting >= 10.x (ADR-006). Hosting 8.0.1 (template default) + generator still emits 4 x IL#### — generator does not intercept Bind<T>() under net10.0 with Configuration.Binder 8.0.2. Verified by architect probe on net10.0.
Native AOT cannot cross-compile OS. Local verify = win-x64 (or PublishTrimmed proxy); production = linux-x64 inside Docker (M7).
Assembly/binary name MUST be `McpWebSearchService` — matches SPEC §5.1 Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT.
M1 template-generated files (Program.cs, RandomNumberTools.cs) only minimally extended in M2 (Options registration). Full refactor deferred to M6.
Invalid configuration MUST fail host startup deterministically (OptionsValidationException) — never silently run with empty BaseUrl/MaxResults=0.

Dockerfile.annotation: Multi-stage Dockerfile (M10 ADR-033: JIT + streamable HTTP — supersedes M7 AOT Dockerfile). Stage 1 (build): mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 (NOT sdk:10.0-aot), dotnet publish src/McpWebSearchService/McpWebSearchService.csproj -c Release -o /app/publish /p:SelfContained=false /p:PublishSingleFile=false (JIT, framework-dependent — runtime provided by aspnet:10.0 base. NOT AOT: no /p:PublishAot=true). Stage 2 (final): mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 (includes Kestrel + ICU + OpenSSL + ca-certificates — supersedes ADR-023 manual apt-get + ADR-024 debian:bookworm-slim). Install curl for HEALTHCHECK. EXPOSE 8080. HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/healthz. ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "McpWebSearchService.dll"] (JIT — NOT native binary). Docker build/run is operator-gated (docker not auto-allowed in opencode.json).
Dockerfile.keywords: docker, multi-stage, jit, http, aspnet, kestrel, linux-x64, healthcheck, curl, entrypoint, dotnet

Dockerfile_BuildStage.annotation: WORKDIR /src. COPY . . (filtered by .dockerignore). RUN dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 -o /app/publish /p:PublishAot=true.

Dockerfile_PublishStep.annotation: Native AOT compilation for linux-x64. Produces McpWebSearchService (no .exe on Linux) + appsettings.json + .mcp/. AOT-clean (0 x IL####, verified via win-x64 proxy ADR-002).

Dockerfile_RuntimeStage.annotation: Minimal runtime image. NO .NET SDK, NO .NET Runtime. ADR-024: debian:bookworm-slim base (SPEC §5.1 fidelity, NOT runtime-deps image).

Dockerfile_AptStep.COMMAND: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates libc6 libgcc-s1 libicu72 libssl3 libstdc++6 tzdata && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
Dockerfile_AptStep.annotation: ADR-023: full runtime-deps set. libicu72 (runtime, NOT -dev), libssl3 (TLS), ca-certificates (HTTPS cert validation), libc6/libgcc-s1/libstdc++6 (native binary base deps), tzdata (parity).

Dockerfile_CopyStep.annotation: Copies native binary McpWebSearchService + appsettings.json + .mcp/ from build stage to /app.

Dockerfile_EntrypointStep.annotation: ADR-004: binary name McpWebSearchService fixed. linux-x64 binary has no .exe extension.

dockerignore.annotation: ADR-025: excludes bin/, obj/, .git/, .opencode/, tests/, .test_counter.json, IDE files (.vs/, .idea/, .vscode/, *.user, *.suo), logs (**/*.log, **/*.tmp, **/*.cache), Dockerfile, .dockerignore, publish/. Captures all log entries into thread-safe List<LogEntry> (lock-based). LogEntry record: { LogLevel, Message, Exception? }. Injected into DI container replacing default ILogger<T> for WebSearchTools, SearXNGClient, SearchResultProcessor. Integration tests assert on captured log content to verify semantic contracts (GREEN TEST TRAP prevention). IsEnabled returns true for all levels — capture everything. Log method formats via formatter callback.
